nodes.name: Slack approval callback
nodes.notes: Set Slack Interactivity Request URL to this workflow's production webhook URL. This responds immediately; verification continues asynchronously.

nodes.name: Verify and parse Slack action
nodes.notes: Self-hosted n8n must permit the built-in crypto module and expose SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET only as a server-side environment variable. Never place it in this node or an export.

parameters.jsCode:
const action = $('Verify and parse Slack action').item.json;
return [{ json: { ...action, action_status: $json.action_status } }];

parameters.query: SELECT id AS report_draft_id, cluster_id, summary, suspected_root_cause, impact, evidence, recommended_next_step FROM ticket_cluster.cluster_report_drafts WHERE id = $1::uuid AND cluster_id = $2::uuid AND status = 'pending_review';

nodes.name: Create approved Google Doc
nodes.notes: Attach the Google Docs OAuth2 credential. Optionally set a shared folder ID.

nodes.name: Write approved report content to Google Doc
nodes.notes: Google Docs Create only creates the file. This explicit OAuth2 update/insert action writes the generated report body. Attach the same Google Docs credential.

nodes.name: Verify approved Google Doc content
nodes.notes: Read the newly created document back from Google before marking delivery successful. Attach the same Google Docs OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: Append approved audit row to Sheets
nodes.notes: Attach Google Sheets credential and create the header row before enabling. Keep this as an audit/dashboard only; Postgres remains source of truth.

parameters.query: UPDATE ticket_cluster.cluster_report_drafts SET status = 'delivered', google_doc_id = $2, google_doc_url = $3, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid; UPDATE ticket_cluster.clusters SET status = 'alerted', alerted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $4::uuid AND status = 'approved';

nodes.name: Mark report delivered and cluster alerted
Rejoin delivery context after Sheets
nodes.notes: The Google Sheets node returns its own response, so restore the report identifiers before updating Postgres.

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $('Prepare delivery audit row').item.json;
return [{ json: { slack_body: { channel: 'REPLACE_WITH_ENGINEERING_ALERTS_CHANNEL_ID', text: `Approved support root-cause alert: ${r.summary} — ${r.google_doc_url}` } } }];

nodes.name: Notify engineering after approval
nodes.notes: Attach HTTP Header Auth using SLACK_BOT_TOKEN as Authorization: Bearer. This node is reachable only after a recorded approve action and successful document/audit delivery.

nodes.name: Verify engineering alert delivered
nodes.notes: Fail visibly if Slack returns ok: false instead of treating an API-level rejection as success.

parameters.query: UPDATE ticket_cluster.cluster_report_drafts SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'reject' THEN 'rejected' WHEN $2 = 'split' THEN 'split' ELSE status END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid;

main.node: Write approved report content to Google Doc
Append approved audit row to Sheets
Mark report delivered and cluster alerted
